children: At Finance Magnates Summit London, trading-floor history is full of lessons that rarely make it into a formal panel. FX Tales returns with practitioners sharing the memorable, surprising and sometimes funny experiences behind London’s trading culture.
Last year, we heard how to clear a pub in 4 seconds, what ‘a job’ was, and what the actual job was like on the trading floor. And this time?

Get ready for yet another instalment of the already-cult London Summit fixture. More tales, more anecdotes, and the usual mix of the funny, the useful, and the reminiscent, breathing life (and LIFFE) to London’s trading world, in the old days and now.At Finance Magnates Summit London 2026 on 24 November, FX Tales #2 offers a different kind of session, placing first-hand experiences and industry history alongside the main programme.

Not every important industry lesson comes from a formal presentation. Some are remembered through the people who experienced the trading floor first-hand, the decisions they made under pressure and the unexpected moments that shaped their careers. FX Tales returns to the Summit to bring those experiences into the conversation.

The session is designed around stories and recollections from practitioners. The programme promises a mix of humour, useful observations and reflections on London's trading culture, both in earlier years and today. It provides a change of pace from sessions focused on regulation, technology and market structure.

For experienced professionals, the discussion offers a chance to reconnect with the history of the business. For newer attendees, it provides context that is difficult to capture in a market report or product demonstration. The value lies in hearing how the industry has evolved through the experiences of those who worked in it.
The session will be hosted between 15:15 and 16:00 on 24 November. You can find more information about the full agenda here.

Industry knowledge is not only passed down through formal panels and presentations. Stories from trading floors can reveal how teams handled pressure, learnt from mistakes and built relationships long before today’s tools and processes existed.

The session setting provides a different rhythm within the Summit programme. Delegates can step away from technical discussions, hear the people behind the industry’s history and use those shared experiences as a starting point for new conversations.Only a few days remain before the summit starts. Now is the time to register.

title: FX Tales #2: (More) Stories from the Floor
